packageRules.description: disable automerge for specific file paths

description: Keep a human in the loop on every openclaw change. PROBLEM: openclaw's upstream carries an
unusually high security-advisory volume, so a bump can carry a behaviour or exposure change
that nobody would see if it merged itself -- including a digest-only refresh, since the
'YYYY.M.P' tag is mutable and gets repointed at rebuilt images. automerge:false is the
policy; the 'automerge:off' label exists so the PR announces it at a glance.
The matcher must be the image reference AS WRITTEN, i.e. the kubernetes manager's depName,
not the colloquial 'org/image'. The deployment writes 'docker.io/ppatlabs/openclaw', so the
previous 'ppatlabs/openclaw' matched nothing and THIS POLICY WAS NOT IN FORCE -- confirmed
in a live 44.30.4 lookup, which resolved the dep with automerge unset. A rule that matches
nothing raises no error, so nothing surfaced it. Both spellings are listed: a bare
'ppatlabs/openclaw' is the depName a '# renovate:' annotation would produce for this image.
Ordering is load-bearing: this preset must stay AFTER override-calver in renovate.json's
extends, because that preset sets automerge:true for calver deps (openclaw is one) and
automerge is a plain boolean -- the last matching rule wins.

packageRules.description: disable automerge for kubevirt -- minor releases have changed behaviour-affecting defaults (e.g. v1.6's VM rollout strategy default flip), every bump gets human review
